description: This file defines the 'cvd' package for managing and interacting with 'CVD' (Android Cuttlefish Virtual Device) instances. It includes data structures for representing groups, instances, and fleet statuses, as well as a CLI wrapper around the 'cvd' command-line tool, providing functions for creating, starting, stopping, removing, fetching, and gathering information about CVD instances.

classes.name: Group
classes.description: Represents a group of CVD instances, containing a name and a list of instances.

classes.name: Instance
classes.description: Represents a single CVD instance with properties like name, status, displays, directory, WebRTC device ID, and ADB serial.

classes.name: Fleet
classes.description: Represents the output of the cvd fleet command, containing multiple groups.

classes.name: FetchCredentials
classes.description: Interface for credentials used to fetch or load CVDs, allowing addition to command-line invocations.

classes.name: FetchTokenFileCredentials
classes.description: Credentials for OAuth2 token, including token string and optional project ID.

classes.name: Selector
classes.description: Filter for selecting specific groups or instances by name.

classes.name: CLI
classes.description: Wrapper around 'cvd' command-line tool providing methods to manage CVD instances.

methods.name: Load
methods.description: Loads a CVD configuration from a file, returning the group information.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a new CVD group with specified selector, options, and whether to start.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Starts the specified CVD group with provided start options.

methods.name: Fleet
methods.description: Retrieves the current fleet status, i.e., all groups and their instances.

methods.name: BugReport
methods.description: Generates a bug report for the specified CVD group, optionally including ADB bug report.

methods.name: TakeSnapshot
methods.description: Takes a snapshot of the specified CVD group.

methods.name: PowerWash
methods.description: Performs a powerwash on the specified CVD group.

methods.name: PowerBtn
methods.description: Simulates pressing the power button for the specified CVD group.

methods.name: Fetch
methods.description: Fetches and prepares build artifacts for CVD based on specified options.
